CLI-191.reason: This report is in the same Apache Commons CLI codebase, so it provides some regional context, but it targets `OptionGroup.setSelected` and a null-handling bug, which is a different subsystem and mechanism from `HelpFormatter.findWrapPos`. The current failure is an index-boundary error in text wrapping logic (`charAt` past `text.length()` due to `<=` vs `<`), so the functional overlap is weak.
